visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair, wearing a navy blue shirt with large white floral prints and khaki pants, stands on an outdoor rooftop. He holds a black handheld camera (Insta360 X5) and speaks directly to the camera with energetic facial expressions. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of a weathered white concrete block. The man strikes the camera lens repeatedly against the concrete edge. He displays the lens to show surface scratches. (3) A screen recording overlay shows a blurred, distorted perspective from the camera's point of view as it is rubbed against the stone. The man laughs and winces as he accidentally slams the device into his finger. (4) An interstitial screen with stylized text appears. The scene transitions to an indoor wooden table. Hands are shown using a specialized black tool to unscrew the round lens element from the camera body. (5) A new, clear glass lens is removed from a white plastic container and screwed onto the camera body by hand. (6) The man returns to the rooftop, holding the repaired camera with a pristine lens, smiling and waving at the camera as he concludes his presentation.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main male creator presenting on the rooftop and demonstrating the product.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: An adult male with short, styled black hair. He is wearing a distinctive navy blue short-sleeved button-up shirt featuring large white 5-petal flower patterns and light-colored khaki trousers.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The primary location is an outdoor rooftop with a weathered white concrete ledge, a window with metal bars, and a view of surrounding urban residential buildings. The secondary location is an indoor setting with a clean wooden desk surface.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Energetic, high-tempo electronic background music with a steady 4/4 kick drum beat begins. A male voice speaks enthusiastically in Mandarin, explaining common misconceptions about camera lens durability. (2) Each time the camera strikes the concrete visually, a distinct, sharp percussive 'thud' sound is heard. The voice fluctuates in pitch to express surprise and amusement. (3) A loud, low-bandwidth scraping noise persists as the lens is rubbed against stone. High-pitched vocal exclamations ('Woah!') are layered over the friction sounds. (4) Multiple heavy 'bang' sounds occur in quick succession. The speaker shouts 'Ah!' followed by a short, high-arousal yelp as he impacts his hand. (5) A bouncy, cartoon-style 'boing' sound effect plays during a transition. (6) Acoustic texture shifts to a quieter room tone. Clear, metallic clicks and plastic ratcheting sounds are heard as tools are used to unscrew and replace the lens. (7) Upbeat music returns to the foreground as the speaker's tone shifts to a satisfied, concluding professional narrative style.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Problem -> Stress Test -> Solution -> Result
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to highlight the extreme durability and unique user-replaceable lens feature of the Insta360 X5. By performing a 'torture test' on the device, the creator proves it is tough to break, and even when scratched, it can be easily fixed at home with a simple tool kit, contrasting it with expensive professional repair costs.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct demonstration of product features, brand logo usage, and positive review of the product's design.
